stem.text: A source of sound waves of constant frequency is travelling as shown.
In which situation would the stationary observer detect a sound with the lowest frequency?

A.alt: Diagram with an observer shown as a dot and a source shown as a dot. A leftward arrow beside the source is labelled 5 m s-1.

B.alt: Diagram with an observer shown as a dot and a source shown as a dot. A leftward arrow beside the source is labelled 10 m s-1.

C.alt: Diagram with an observer shown as a dot and a source shown as a dot. A rightward arrow beside the source is labelled 5 m s-1.

D.alt: Diagram with an observer shown as a dot and a source shown as a dot. A rightward arrow beside the source is labelled 10 m s-1.
